The implementation in `bottle_song.go`:
- **`numberWords`** — map of counts 0–10 to capitalized words (`"No"` … `"Ten"`).
- **`bottleName(count)`** — returns `"green bottle"` for 1, `"green bottles"` otherwise (the singular/plural distinction from the spec).
- **`verse(count)`** — builds the four lines of a verse, lowercasing the first letter of the number for the "There'll be …" line (e.g. "There'll be nine green bottles…").
- **`Recite(startBottles, takeDown)`** — appends `takeDown` verses starting at `startBottles`, separating verses with a blank line.

One note: the test file defines a `Title` helper, but since it's only compiled during tests, I used a small `lowerFirst` helper in the solution file instead so the package builds standalone. No test files were modified and no new files were created.
